stemMd: Which statement negates “At least one delivery arrived late”?
explanationMd: “At least one” is false only when there are zero examples. Therefore the negation is that no delivery arrived late. The presence of some on-time deliveries alone does not rule out a late one.

distractorRationale.b: This strengthens rather than negates the original.
distractorRationale.e: This still satisfies at least one.
distractorRationale.d: Late and on-time deliveries can coexist.
distractorRationale.a: This also entails at least one late delivery.
